author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
**New Help Menu** installed!

This cog replaces Red's help system and optionally converts ALL embeds & menus to Discord Components V2.

Get started:
- `[p]cv2 toggle` — Enable Components V2 (off by default)
- `[p]cv2 settings` — View all current settings
- `[p]cv2 color <hex>` — Set accent colour
- `[p]cv2 category add <name> <cog1> <cog2>...` — Group cogs into categories

Components V2 is **off by default** — enable it when you're ready!
name: NewHelpMenu
short: Components V2 help menu + global embed/menu override
description: A mega cog that replaces Red's entire help system with Discord Components V2 (containers, sections, text displays, thumbnails, media galleries, separators) and optionally converts ALL bot embeds and menus into Components V2 layouts. Fully customisable with categories, accent colours, layout modes, per-server settings. Toggle on/off with default off.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild configuration. No personal user data is stored.
